description: Java class ReportReader for parsing and processing report data files related to engine parameters such as RPM and MAF, including filtering and mapping data.

classes.name: ReportReader
classes.description: Main class for reading, filtering, and mapping report data files containing engine parameter logs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point, calls readMap with a filename.

methods.name: readMap
methods.description: Reads a file, filters data, finds min/max values, and returns a map of RPM to MAF to ReportLine.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Converts a list of ReportLine objects into a nested map structure grouped by RPM and MAF.

methods.name: findMinMax
methods.description: Calculates and logs the min and max values for MAF and RPM from the data.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters out invalid data points based on RPM difference threshold.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads lines from a file and converts them into ReportLine objects.

methods.name: handleOneLine
methods.description: Parses a line of text into a ReportLine object if it matches the pattern.
